entities.summary: Francisco "Pako" Javier Cruz Saldívar is a Mexican professional basketball player for Mersin MSK of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). He also represents the senior Mexico national basketball team. He played NCAA Division I college basketball at Wyoming. He is a 1.91 m tall shooting guard, that can also play as a small forward.
